_about: Hand-checked first new-subdivision residential permits, used where the automatic rule picks up permits on old rural lots. Each entry replaces the automatic first permit for that plan.

Horse Hill ASP.note: Earlier permits in the plan area (2010-2013) are houses and modular homes on existing acreages; subdivision building began in Marquis in Sept 2022.

Marquis NSP.note: Same as Horse Hill ASP: first permit on a new Marquis street.
